experiments.why: A one-argument call on an odd pane size, where the new default span must keep cssScale times VIEW_PX equal to 1013 exactly.
A zero-size pane through the new default span, which must still give renderScale 1 and a buffer of VIEW_PX.
A debug-view call with a pulled-back span, which the old code ignores and the new code uses for the buffer, scale and stretch.
A debug span wider than the pane, where the new code keeps renderScale 1 with a buffer of the whole span and a cssScale below 1.
A heavy outline called without the new opacity argument, whose two lines must keep full and HEAVY_INSET_OPACITY opacity and the same 5-point positions.
A heavy outline with the new faint opacity, which the new code applies to the outer line and multiplies into the inset line.

source.quote: renders on a whole pixel grid

obligations.statement: For pane sizes such as 375, 421, 900 and 1013 CSS pixels, fitViewport(pane) returns an integer renderScale and a bufferPx that is a whole multiple of VIEW_PX.
fitViewport(pane).cssScale multiplied by VIEW_PX equals the pane size exactly, e.g. 1013 for a 1013-pixel pane.

source.quote: never renders below one pixel per world pixel

obligations.statement: For a pane smaller than the view, such as 60 CSS pixels, fitViewport(pane) returns renderScale 1, bufferPx equal to VIEW_PX and a cssScale below 1.

source.quote: survives a pane with no size yet

obligations.statement: fitViewport(0) returns renderScale 1 and bufferPx equal to VIEW_PX.

source.quote: shows the same world at every pane size

obligations.statement: For the play view, fitViewport(pane) returns bufferPx divided by renderScale equal to VIEW_PX at every pane size (such as 200, 375, 900, 1440 and 2560), so a larger pane never shows more of the world.

source.quote: Axis-aligned outline in world pixels — an explicit 5-point line, not

obligations.statement: Called as before without any new trailing argument, makeRectOutline(originX, originY, w, h, color, heavy) returns lines whose positions are the same explicit 5-point axis-aligned outline of the w by h rectangle at (originX, originY) in world pixels, in the given color.

source.quote: omits the player from the bake

obligations.statement: On the shipped tile catalogue, dynamicLightTileIds(tilesById) contains PLAYER_TILE_ID, so the player is left out of the static light bake.

source.quote: is thrown away without taking the sprite's quad with it

obligations.statement: disposeGroupChildren(group, materials) on a group holding an outline made by makeFollowingSpriteOutline empties the group but leaves the followed sprite's shared geometry intact, with its position attribute still defined.
When given the OutlineMaterials pool, disposeGroupChildren empties the group without disposing a pooled outline mesh's material, which goes back to the pool instead.

source.quote: draws from the sprite's own quad, so a frame flip needs no telling

obligations.statement: makeFollowingSpriteOutline(source, color, materials) returns an outline mesh whose geometry is the very same object as source.geometry, not a copy.

source.quote: gives up on a mesh with no art rather than outlining nothing

obligations.statement: makeFollowingSpriteOutline returns null when the source mesh's material has no texture map.
